t: This is Tottenham Court Road, a major road in Central London, lying almost entirely within the London Borough of Camden. It's a long, busy street, and you're standing on just one stretch of it. The engraver William Alexander Le Petit was born here in 1804. He worked as a topographical engraver and printmaker, and he was active in the late 1820s and 1830s. He died in 1891.
